rows.notes: The study is a narrative review of remote sensing (hyperspectral, visible light/canopy colour, UAV, satellite) for plant nutrition diagnosis. It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs; all tables (Tables 1-3) and results are reproduced from cited works (e.g. Li et al. [25], Wang et al. [49], Liu et al. [24]). The forward-looking statement in the abstract that remote sensing will be more widely used with satellite/UAV/IoT development is an opinion, not a finding. Q1 is therefore 'no' and all other questions are 'no'.

notes: Full text appears complete (abstract through references). The paper is a review article with no primary data; it cannot provide primary evidence for any claim.
